how_to_apply: Download the application form from the ILBS website at https://www.ilbs.in/images/media/faculty-form.pdf.
Fill in the form and send it by email to [email protected] latest by 30 November 2026.
Pay the application fee by electronic transfer; the payment details are in the application form.
Attach photocopies of degree, certificate, diploma, testimonials and experience certificates along with the application.
Also submit a recent passport size photo, the date of birth entry from the matriculation certificate or SSLC, and duly attested copies of the degree certificate or diploma.

The notice names the Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences, D - 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi - 110070 as the Institute and mentions only email for sending applications. For queries, call the HR department on 011-46300000, Ex: 23234 and 23233.

The fee is non-refundable and cannot be refunded once deposited or submitted. It is paid by electronic transfer to Account No. 50100143852078, RTGS/NEFT IFSC - HDFC0000273, HDFC Bank, Site No. 2, OCF Pocket, Sector - C, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070.

All applications are screened by the Screening Committee as per the Recruitment Rule of the post. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed and other academic achievements. The notice does not give an interview date, a written test or marks.
important_instructions: The Institute may reject any or all applications without giving reasons, and no appeal will be entertained. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct of the interview or the reasons for not being called for interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction of court will be Delhi/New Delhi only.

content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences is an autonomous super-specialty institute under GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University by the UGC. Its stated vision is to be a global leader in patient care, teaching and research in the field of liver, gall bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases. Its address is D - 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi - 110070.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: ILBS has listed 10 vacancies in 8 posts. The vacancies are tentative: the notice says they are subject to change at any time and that the Institute reserves the right whether or not to fill any post. The vacancy may be removed from the ILBS website once a post is filled. A post that falls vacant can also be added at the discretion of ILBS.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print the educational qualification or experience for any of the 8 posts. It says the Recruitment Rules are on the Recruitment Rules page under Career Opportunities on the ILBS website, http://www.ilbs.in , and that candidates should go through the Recruitment Rules and category there before applying or appearing for interview. Working knowledge of Computer is essential for all the posts. Candidates should check the official notification and Recruitment Rules for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The notice prints an upper age limit in years for each post. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age. For the post reserved for the OBC category (Consultant (Anaesthesia) Grade IV), only applications from candidates holding an OBC certificate issued by GNCT of Delhi will be considered. Candidates with disabilities can apply as per the definition in the Persons with Disabilities (equal opportunities, protection of rights and full participation) Act, 1995. Only persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PWD reservation benefit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay package is based on the 7th CPC at the pay level applicable for the Institute. The notice does not name any allowances. All 8 posts are on "Contract Basis" for a period of one year. Either side can end the contract by giving the other party not less than three months notice in writing, or salary in lieu of the notice period. The date of joining of selected candidates and other conditions will be as per the HR policy of the Institute.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies in 8 posts: 1 each in seven posts and 3 for Consultant (Anaesthesia) Grade IV (2-UR, 1-OBC). The notice says the vacancies are subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ILBS faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ILBS Assistant Professor and Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years for seven posts and 55 years for Consultant (Data Scientist – AI Health) Grade III. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 590/- (Rs. 500/- + 18% GST), and Rs. 118/- for SC/ST, EWS and Ex-Serviceman candidates. Persons with disabilities pay no fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://www.ilbs.in/images/media/faculty-form.pdf and email it to [email protected] with photocopies of certificates and experience documents, a passport size photo and the date of birth proof.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for ILBS Consultant and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Remuneration is PB - IV, GP - 8700 for seven posts and PB - IV, GP - 9500 for Consultant (Data Scientist – AI Health) Grade III, as per the pre-revised 7th CPC pay level applicable for the Institute.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The Screening Committee screens all applications as per the Recruitment Rule of the post, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are the ILBS faculty posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. All 8 posts are on Contract Basis for a period of one year, and either side can end the contract with not less than three months notice in writing or salary in lieu.

faq.question: Q9. Which post is reserved for OBC candidates?
faq.answer: One of the three Consultant (Anaesthesia) Grade IV posts is reserved for OBC. Only OBC certificates issued by GNCT of Delhi are considered for it.

faq.question: Q10. Is computer knowledge required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says working knowledge of Computer is essential for all the posts.
